reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

title.narrative: Allianz Bank Bulgaria Senior Preferred Bond

description.narrative: The EBRD invested EUR 7.9 million in a senior preferred bond issuance of EUR 39.5 million by Allianz Bank Bulgaria AD ("ABB"), a commercial bank incorporated in Bulgaria. The bond has a 4-year maturity, with a call option after the third year, and is expected to be listed on the Bulgarian Stock Exchange within 6 months after issuance. 150 percent of EBRD's investment in the bonds issued by ABB will be used for eligible projects in line with EBRD's Green Economy Transition ("GET") criteria. The project facilitates capital market development in Bulgaria, supports the resilience of ABB and helps to deliver the EBRD's green agenda in the country and national green economy priorities.
